memos.headline: Small-bank beat of 7 cents, partly a lower provision; out pre-open, stock already +2.2% on thin trade
reasoning: Primary source: 8-K item 2.02 filed 11:14 ET, Exhibit 99.1 'Capital City Bank Group, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results'. Benzinga had the numbers at 07:01 ET ('Q3 EPS $0.99 Beats $0.92 Estimate, Sales $64.394M Miss $65.400M Estimate'), so the release preceded the filing by four hours: late.

Quoted: 'net income attributable to common shareowners of $16.9 million, or $0.99 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026 compared to $16.3 million, or $0.95 per diluted share, for the second quarter'.

Quoted: 'Net interest margin increased 7 basis points to 4.42%'; 'Credit loss provision decreased $1.0 million'; 'Noninterest income decreased $1.2 million, or 5.9%'; 'Loan balances decreased $10.3 million, or 0.4% (average)'.
What changed: little. Earnings rose 4 cents on the quarter, and part of that is a smaller provision; loans shrank and fee income fell. Revenue missed by Benzinga's estimate.

Already traded: the release went out before the open and CCBG is +2.2% today (48.665 to 49.76), on 1,097 IEX shares; since the 11:14 filing there have been no IEX trades at all, so we cannot read the reaction or fill cleanly.
objections: Late: the release came out at 07:01 ET, four hours before the filing.
Routine quarter: a 7-cent beat helped by a lower provision, with a revenue miss; no outlook change.
Too thin on IEX to read or trade the reaction.

memos.headline: Unconfirmed: a takeover rumor from an M&A blog, no statement from Qiagen or any bidder
reasoning: The story is not a source. Benzinga 15:06 UTC, quoted in full: 'Watching Qiagen; Shares Move Higher, Traders Circulate Unconfirmed Rumor From M&A Blog Suggesting The Co Is Seeing Takeover Interest'. No body text, no named blog, no named bidder.
Primary source: none. Qiagen has made no statement; there is no filing, no exchange notice, no regulator notice. This is UNCONFIRMED and is flagged as such.
The move came first and the headline describes it: QGEN is +3.6% on the day (46.54 to 48.20) on 176,833 IEX shares, about 1.5x its recent days; since the headline it is only +0.9%.
Nothing changed for the business that we can quote. The crew has no way to test a rumor's odds, and a denial or silence usually gives the move back.
objections: Unconfirmed rumor with no primary source; the price move preceded and prompted the headline.

Primary source: none. Neither Tesla nor SpaceX has announced or filed anything about a merger; the article is opinion about a possibility.
Nothing changed for the business. TSLA is -0.6% since the article, which is noise for this stock.
